owner_source.body:
## Approved direction
Craig approved publishing the garage design to GitHub, creating tasks and proceeding mock-first on 2026-10-07. This issue is the discoverable feature index, not a bundled defect that can close its child tasks.

- [Central design, board and execution brief: draft PR #327](https://github.com/doublehidenblade/game-dev-central/pull/327)
- [Canonical game-repo task files: draft PR #449](https://github.com/doublehidenblade/tokyo-drift-3d/pull/449)
- [Full design](https://github.com/doublehidenblade/game-dev-central/blob/design/garage-progression-20261007/game-design/garage-progression.md)
- [Ownership, visual workflow and first-slice acceptance](https://github.com/doublehidenblade/game-dev-central/blob/design/garage-progression-20261007/project-management/task-team-system/briefs/garage-progression-first-slice.md)

## Dependency queue
- [ ] [td-197: Garage reference mocks and measured layout gate](https://github.com/doublehidenblade/tokyo-drift-3d/blob/tasks/td-197-202-garage-progression/godot/docs/tasks/td-197.md)
- [ ] [td-198: Driveable garage graybox in the actual Lower City](https://github.com/doublehidenblade/tokyo-drift-3d/blob/tasks/td-197-202-garage-progression/godot/docs/tasks/td-198.md)
- [ ] [td-199: Garage entry, shutter and police shelter contract](https://github.com/doublehidenblade/tokyo-drift-3d/blob/tasks/td-197-202-garage-progression/godot/docs/tasks/td-199.md)
- [ ] [td-200: Atomic garage inventory and fixed supplier first loop](https://github.com/doublehidenblade/tokyo-drift-3d/blob/tasks/td-197-202-garage-progression/godot/docs/tasks/td-200.md)
- [ ] [td-201: Phone workshop UI and prerequisite-aware discovery](https://github.com/doublehidenblade/tokyo-drift-3d/blob/tasks/td-197-202-garage-progression/godot/docs/tasks/td-201.md)
- [ ] [td-202: Independent garage first-slice integration validation](https://github.com/doublehidenblade/tokyo-drift-3d/blob/tasks/td-197-202-garage-progression/godot/docs/tasks/td-202.md)

Each task closes only on its own criterion-cited independent verdict, never because its sibling or this epic changed state.

## Ownership and present status
Owner of the new garage lane: dot. Runtime worker assignment: **pending confirmed admission**. Task specs/board rows are planned and blocked; creation of this issue or a PR is not worker dispatch. Mocks are first, then measured-layout review before actual 3D work. Craig waived a mandatory design-review pause, not actual-world evidence.

Existing Muse/Claude work stays with its owner: td-185/186 Lower City, gigs and Asset Forge; td-188–196 pedestrians, traffic, cops and arrest. No external owner is contacted, reassigned or taken over here. Garage consumes explicit capability, settlement, police sight/recovery and blueprint-reward contracts. Missing owner interfaces block the dependent acceptance gate.

## First-slice scope
One real drive-in garage/shutter; safe park/exit and police sight-gated shelter without heat reset; three fixed physically discovered suppliers; visible packs hauled home; atomic persistent wallet/inventory/save recovery; one rack-versus-padded fitting; contextual phone/controller UI with hidden skipped tiers; two actual capability-consuming gig variants via the existing gig owner.

Later refrigerator/electrical and adjoining-bay/van goals use a few short blueprint delivery beats, with real floor/storage expansion. Timber depot/alcove and full catalogue stay later. No property empire, full catalogue implementation or on-foot crafting.

## Hard acceptance gates
Measured mocks are direction only. Graybox, shelter, supplies and UI must be verified inside the actual Lower City with the actual car. Test LOS loss/regain during entry/closure; physical shutter obstruction/occlusion; reload/double-click at every transaction boundary; full/partial storage; mixed client cargo and supplies; hidden reveal states; readable phone controls; safe zero-cash recovery. No feature completion without both useful fitting choices and the real gig-consumer loop.

Documentation-only publication. No implementation, runtime test pass, merge, deployment, GitHub Actions dispatch/rerun or accepted mock gate is claimed.
